messages:
dara: quick sync — final pass on internal release note for v6.0.0. we have a VIP sticky pin request from AcmeCorp; need that line exact in blast. also want deploy-bot dry-run so SRE sees cues.
evan: thanks. suggested blurb: 'v6.0.0: adaptive batching & kernel selection for lower tail latency. No API changes; backward compatible.' two lines.
sophia: confirmed AcmeCorp pinned artifact: runtime-enterprise@v6.0.0 (sha: c0ffee1). pls include 'Pinned for AcmeCorp' line under accounts heading.
dara: add rollback guard: auto rollback to v5.9.7 if 4m error rate > 0.6% OR p95 latency increases > 30% over 4m.
release-coordinator: also include a rollforward note: if rollout stuck at ramp due to capacity, ops can roll forward to small dedicated pool (dedicated-hot) for VIP traffic, then investigate.
evan: can we mute noisy token-cost alerts? oncall prefers threshold increase for first 6m instead of muting.
oncall: agree — we'll bump token-cost alert and p95 delta thresholds for first 6m. won't silence alerts.
dara: @deploy-bot run a staging dry-run with the exact blurb and account pin so docs can copy verbatim. tag thread 9755555555.
deploy-bot: staging dry-run started for thread 9755555555. emitting messages flagged [staging-dry-run]. ETA ~2m.
deploy-bot: dry-run output:
- "[STAGING-DRY] Release v6.0.0 scheduled. Canary: us-west 20m -> ramp 50% over 20m. Pin: runtime-enterprise@v6.0.0 (c0ffee1) — Pinned for AcmeCorp"
- "Rollback policy: if 4m error rate > 0.6% OR p95 latency +30% -> automatic rollback to v5.9.7"
- "Rollforward lane: if capacity constraints, route AcmeCorp traffic to dedicated-hot pool (manual opt-in by ops). See evacuation runbook link in thread."
- "Owners: dara (release), sophia (accounts), evan (docs), release-coordinator (deploy), oncall (pager)"
dara: good. can someone paste the deploy config snippet for docs appendix? want it exact.
evan: snippet: ```
canary: { region: "us-west", duration: "20m" }
ramp: { to: "50%", duration: "20m" }
pin: "runtime-enterprise@v6.0.0 (c0ffee1) - Pinned for AcmeCorp"
blackout: { region: "eu", start: "23:00Z", end: "02:00Z" }
alerts: { initial_adjust: { token_cost: "+30%", p95_delta: "+40%", window: "6m" } }
rollback: { window: "4m", error_rate: "0.6%", p95_delta: "+30%", fallback: "v5.9.7" }
rollforward: { dedicated_pool: "dedicated-hot", manual_by: "ops" }
```
sophia: perfect. i'll add the exact 'Pinned for AcmeCorp' line to the account-rep note and DM the reps. @acct-rep can you confirm account outreach?
acct-rep: yep — i've queued the heads-up message to AcmeCorp and will include the pinned artifact string.
dara: who will post the internal slack blast? want it T-9 before canary. also pin the thread.
release-coordinator: i can post and pin. scheduling for 2024-09-03T08:21:00Z (T-9). will tag owners and AcmeCorp rep.
oncall: once posted i'll validate pager thresholds reflect the 'initial_adjust' values. also will run the evacuation runbook checklist during canary.
dara: include link to runbook in notes: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/evacuate-v6-canary (docs team, paste in doc).
evan: small editorial nit — change 'No API changes; backward compatible.' to 'No API changes; backward compatible across SDKs.'
sophia: done. final blurb: 'v6.0.0: adaptive batching & kernel selection for lower tail latency. No API changes; backward compatible across SDKs.'
dara: perfect. leaving thread open for any last-minute microcopy edits. thanks all :shipit:
